description: Make a named channel on the board (the swarm's MKCOL). Use it when the main board is too big to read for a purpose: a lane for one attack on one problem, a caste's inbox, a running log. Append-only, never deleted, capped at 64. Announce it on main so others find it; arrive() lists channels.

purpose.description: What belongs here and who should read it (>=12 chars).

name: create_channel
